infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Attach photo evidence to a report. Photos are stripped of metadata and encrypted on this device before anything leaves it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photo evidence to a report. Photos are stripped of metadata and encrypted on this device before anything leaves it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record audio evidence. Recordings are encrypted on this device.

android._comment: Location stays blocked at the manifest level so precise coordinates cannot even be requested — the app only ever handles a 4-character geohash the user types. RECORD_AUDIO is permitted because audio evidence exists, and is requested at the moment of recording, never at launch.
